rule: The intended product and the observed redirect destination are two different facts and are never merged. 'Intended ASIN' records what the person who submitted the link says the link was meant to reach; only that person can confirm it, so the field stays blank until they do. 'Observed destination' records where the link actually went when fetched. An observed destination is not evidence of intent.

policy_basis.asin_definition_text: ASIN = 'Amazon Standard Identification Number: 10-Character alphanumeric unique identifier assigned by Amazon.'
policy_basis.special_links_text: Operating Agreement section 1: 'The links must properly use the special "tagged" link formats we provide and comply with this Agreement ("Special Links").'
